description: Give an organization member another role: owner, manager or viewer. memberId is the member id from list_members, not the user id. Requires a confirmationToken: call preview_operation with tool "change_member_role" and these arguments first, show the returned plan to the user, and call this tool only after the user explicitly agrees. Needs the organization:manage permission and the owner role.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name: change_member_role
title: Change a member's role
